The '''''Star of Coruscant''''' was a [[superdreadnaught]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].

==Description==
The ship was enormous in size and was equipped with both experimental weapons and technology.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|''Star of Coruscant''}}</ref>

==History==
The ship was created under the supervision of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Laren Omas|Omas]]. It was targeted specifically by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and defeated in the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]. The vessel plunged from orbit onto [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] icy surface.<ref name="TORC" />

Despite the long fall, the ship's hull remained intact and the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group later turned the derelict into a fortress, reactivating the ship's power systems and defensive shields.<ref name="TORC" />

[[File:Anti-Intrusion_droid_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Alliance Commander]]'s [[anti-Intrusion droid]] searching for [[Greb Besrik]].]]
The ship was later encountered by adventurers traversing the Hoth ice plains.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Threads Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]] went to the ship to [[Mission to Hoth (Third Galactic War)|search]] the whereabouts of [[Greb Besrik]], a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who worked for [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]]'s mercenary team.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Hoth Pursuit|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>
